Game Overview

In Tower Defenders, the core idea is straightforward: defend against undead Viking hordes in "Tower Defenders" with strategic tower placement and upgrades. Infinite gameplay keeps you on edge as you utilize powerful magic cards and rewards for enhancement. Survive as long as possible by balancing offensive and defensive tactics, ensuring endless wave-challenging fun.
